_notes: Rules that are not per-action. UNVERIFIED marks a simulator assumption rather than a sourced fact.

queen._potency_scale_note: The Balance's 'normalized pet potency' (2368 at 100 battery) over the raw 2660: pets do not inherit every player multiplier.
queen._hits_note: Coefficients are potency per point of battery (job guide: 120-240, 240-480, 340-680, 390-780). The sequence of one Roller Dash, three Arm Punches, Pile Bunker and Crowned Collider reproduces The Balance's 26.6 potency per battery. Offsets from the summon are UNVERIFIED: first hit ~5 s after the summon, finishers at the end of ~16 s.
